target.title: fix(oauth): redact Anthropic OAuth error response body and URL
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`postJson()` and `refreshAnthropicToken()` in `src/llm/utils/oauth/anthropic.ts`
embedded the URL and raw response body in Error messages on non-2xx responses.
The URL may contain OAuth callback parameters, and the body may contain tokens
or error descriptions — both could surface in logs or error reports.

Follow-up to #102953 which fixed the same pattern in Copilot OAuth.

## Why This Change Was Made

- `postJson()`: moved `assertOkOrThrowProviderError` **before** body consumption
  (`readResponseWithLimit`), so the bounded/redacted helper reads the body
  instead of consuming it first with the 16 MiB success cap.
- `refreshAnthropicToken()`: removed `url=${TOKEN_URL}` and `details=${formatErrorDetails(error)}`
  from the outer catch; preserved the inner error message via `cause`.

## User Impact

**Before:** `...url=https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token; details=Error: Anthropic OAuth request failed with status 400: bad [code=invalid_grant]; stack=...`
**After:** `Anthropic token refresh request failed: Anthropic OAuth request (400): The refresh *** is invalid or has expired. [code=invalid_grant]`

## Evidence

### Targeted path proof (Anthropic OAuth via assertOkOrThrowProviderError)

Real HTTP 400 with OAuth error + x-request-id header → `assertOkOrThrowProviderError(response, "Anthropic OAuth request")` **before** body read:

```
=== #103269 Proof: assertOkOrThrowProviderError on Anthropic OAuth path ===
Error thrown: PASS
ProviderHttpError instance: PASS
Error name ProviderHttpError: PASS
Status 400: PASS
Label "Anthropic OAuth request": PASS
Raw JSON not leaked: PASS
error_description not leaked: PASS
URL not leaked: PASS
body= not leaked: PASS
Structured code invalid_grant: PASS
Request id preserved: PASS

Message: Anthropic OAuth request (400): The refresh *** is invalid or has expired. [code=invalid_grant] [request_id=req_test_abc123]
Code: invalid_grant
RequestId: req_test_abc123

Overall: ALL PASS
```

### Regression tests

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/llm/utils/oauth/anthropic.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  13 passed (13)
```

### Checks

- oxfmt — passed
- oxlint — passed
- git diff --check — passed

### Diff

```

src/llm/utils/oauth/anthropic.test.ts | 26 ++++++ (regression test)
```
